new_leads: Recurring top-tier co-distributors alongside HalabTech: Adyunlocker (Dubai/Jordan), GsmServer (HK), GsmGenesis (US/India), GSM-T-TOOL (Iraq), Hali-Unlock (Yemen), GsmEasy (China), Fast Provision (BD), Clean Unlocker, Gsm Fastest. These are the best candidates for intermediate suppliers on lines where HalabTech is reseller-tier or absent (SamKey, AMT, MH Unlocker, Global Unlocker Pro, T-Tool Pro, CellTool, Panda, AWT).

Yemen tool family (Hunter Unlocker, Q-Unlocker, Global Unlocker Pro, KEY-Tool, Tira Unlocker, likely T-Unlock): shared site template and 'distributors only' policy. HalabTech is a top distributor for Hunter and Q-Unlocker but only a reseller for Global Unlocker Pro. Hali-Unlock (haliunlock.com, +967) is a distributor across all of them and a candidate source for Global Unlocker/KEY-Tool/Tira.

Thai tool family (RTC Tool, MTK GoGo, SimTool, GSMunlock): HalabTech's catalog uses an identical service template ('Create New User + Credits (Instant/Auto API)' / 'Transfer Credits to Existing Account (Instant/Auto API)'), which suggests one common upstream API source. LIKELY at most; PLUK-GSM (RTC 'Distributor WorldWide', RTC.Tool2021@gmail.com) is a candidate.

New HalabTech identifiers seen on vendor pages: +905300229173 with hosamkashto@gmail.com (T-Tool Pro, Xiaomi Pro Tool, AuthFlash +90 5300229173); +905070585173 (Q-Unlocker); skype 'htsupport' (Piranha); +249116472371 (S-Finder; Sudanese number, anomaly).

Global Unlocker Pro lists 'All Unlocker' (allunlocker.com, WhatsApp +962789940944) with Email info@halabtech.com. This is either an affiliate or front of HalabTech, or a data-entry error; worth checking allunlocker.com (KEY-Tool also lists 'All UnLocker').

Vendor pages not in the catalog that also list HalabTech (snippet only): HW Pro Tool (hw-pro.com/resellers, Distributor), Pegasus Tools (pegasus-tools.com/resellers), TurboSchematics (Trusted Resellers), Brutal Forensic Tool (Official Seller, support.halabtech.com), z3x-team.com/where-to-buy (Halabtech for Syria/Lebanon/Germany/Turkey), hydradongle.com/agents (Syria + Turkey), infinity-box.com/buy. These belong to major-vendor streams.

Apizu Tool publishes a vendor-run Dhru Fusion Reseller API (apizutool.one/reseller-api/api.php), and CF-Tools provides a DHRU integration script (cftools.php). These are concrete examples of direct vendor-to-Dhru API supply that HalabTech could use; check HalabTech's service delivery times/labels for these lines.
KEY-Tool: HalabTech sells 'Make & Recharged Distributor 200/500/1000 Credit [Auto API]', so it can create KEY-Tool distributor accounts. Ask whether that needs a vendor-level (master) account.
